Visit note | 2025-07-19 03:00 PM | Dr. Nusrat Jahan, General Medicine | Patient: Sajjad Hossain, 45, male. This is a review visit for Mr. Hossain, who reports aching all over his body along with a persistent fever for the past two to three days. He works as a nurse and notes his illness began after several relatives in Noakhali suffered from the same fever. He has a known history of Hypothyroidism. He reports no cough, chest pain, or breathing difficulty. On examination: temperature 102.0°F, BP 135/72 mmHg, pulse 97 bpm, and weight 50 kg. Chest is clear and throat is mildly congested. Assessment: Viral fever. Plan: a prescription was issued today. He was advised to drink plenty of fluids, rest at home for three days, and sponge with lukewarm water if the fever is high. Follow-up in 3 days if the fever does not settle.

Follow-up in 4 weeks.
